issues.description: The solution repository defines Animal and the concrete animal constructors to take (String name, int age) and adds an 'age' attribute to Animal, while the problem statement and the template Main use/describe constructors with only a name (animals only have a name). This constructor/attribute mismatch will confuse students (and makes the example Main in the template/problem invalid) because the expected constructors and attributes differ between artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the design consistent: either (A) remove the extra 'age' attribute from Animal and change all concrete animal constructors in the solution to a single parameter (String name) so they match the problem text and template Main; or (B) update the problem statement and the template Main examples to require and show two-argument constructors (String name, int age) and document the added 'age' attribute. Prefer option A to match the UML and problem description that only mention 'name'.
